item.title: Ukraine arrests key members of ransomware gang that extorted $40.5 million posing as IT support
item.description: Four key members of a ransomware group that took more than $40.5 million from at least 28 companies have been detained in Ukraine. The group’s members posed as IT support staff on phone calls to break into corporate networks, according to Ukraine’s National Police. The arrests followed an investigation that Ukrainian police ran with the FBI for more than two years. item.title: GTA 6 scams are after your Google password, money, and crypto wallet
item.description: Scammers are using the GTA 6 launch to steal Google passwords, sell game keys that may never arrive, and get players to connect crypto wallets. Stefan Dasic, a senior malware research engineer at Malwarebytes, tracked the lures. They range from fake giveaways to a phone app that mostly serves ads.
